svg.title: A confused client was placed on hourly rounding with a bed exit alarm 24 hours ago as an alternative to restraints. Which finding indicates the plan has been effective?
svg.desc: The plan is judged effective when the client stays safe without restraints . Turning off the alarm is the tempting choice because it addressed the client's agitation, but disabling the safety device removes the very intervention being evaluated and leaves the client unprotected.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
Restraint Alternatives
Read the situation
A confused client was placed on hourly
rounding with a bed exit alarm 24 hours
ago as an alternative to restraints. Which
finding indicates the plan has been
effective?
What fits here
The client has had no falls and no
restraints have been required in 24 hours
Why it fits
The plan is judged effective when the
client stays safe without restraints .
Turning off the alarm is the tempting
choice because it addressed the client's
agitation, but disabling the safety device
removes the very intervention being
evaluated and leaves the client
unprotected.
